description: This source file implements the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface for the Rialto client, including factory methods, IPC channel management, event subscription, and control commands such as play, pause, set volume, and buffer management.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating WebAudioPlayer IPC instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for WebAudioPlayer IPC instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Implementation of the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface, managing IPC communication, event subscription, and control commands.

methods.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the WebAudioPlayer IPC factory instance.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory::createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer IPC instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC channel, creates the web audio player, and sets up event handling.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::~WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the web audio player session, detaches the IPC channel, and resets the event thread.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates the RPC stub for communication with the WebAudioPlayer module.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to WebAudioPlayer state events over the IPC channel.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::onPlaybackStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles playback state update events and notifies the client.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::play
methods.description: Sends a play command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::pause
methods.description: Sends a pause command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::setEos
methods.description: Sends an end-of-stream command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio buffer data via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new web audio player instance via IPC with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the web audio player instance via IPC.
